findings.title: Symmetric HS256 Algorithm Used for JWT Signing Instead of Asymmetric RS256
findings.description: The JWT token generator utilizes HMAC-SHA256 with a shared symmetric secret key, exposing token verification to cross-service secret compromise.
findings.impact: If a backend worker or microservice secret is exposed, attackers can forge valid authentication tokens.
findings.recommended_fix: Migrate to RS256 asymmetric keypairs where the auth gateway holds the private key and consumer services hold the public key.
findings.remediation_diff:
--- a/backend/routes/auth.py
+++ b/backend/routes/auth.py
@@ -28,3 +28,3 @@
- token = jwt.encode(payload, settings.JWT_SECRET, algorithm="HS256")
+ token = jwt.encode(payload, settings.RSA_PRIVATE_KEY, algorithm="RS256")

findings.title: Missing Tenant Isolation Check on Project Context Retrieval
findings.description: Endpoint /api/projects/{project_id}/memory does not enforce user ownership validation before returning project memory nodes.
findings.impact: Authenticated users could potentially view project metadata of other tenants if they guess the project ID.
findings.recommended_fix: Add verified current_user.id ownership constraint to query filters.
findings.remediation_diff:
--- a/backend/routes/project_memory_routes.py
+++ b/backend/routes/project_memory_routes.py
@@ -35,3 +35,3 @@
- project = db.query(Project).filter(Project.id == project_id).first()
+ project = db.query(Project).filter(Project.id == project_id, Project.owner_id == current_user.id).first()

findings.title: Unsanitized External Document Parsing in RAG Embedding Pipeline
findings.description: Untrusted user-uploaded PDF/Markdown documents are injected directly into system prompts without delimiter isolation or instruction sanitization.
findings.impact: Malicious documents could override AI system prompt instructions via prompt injection.
findings.recommended_fix: Wrap retrieved document text in strict XML tags (<context>...</context>) and instruct the model to treat content strictly as untrusted data.
findings.owasp_category: OWASP Top 10 for LLM: LLM01 Prompt Injection

findings.title: Exposed Test API Key Token in Environment Example File
findings.description: Detected Stripe test secret token pattern sk_test_51Mz... in sample env file.
findings.impact: Low direct impact as it is a test key, but violates clean repository hygiene.
findings.recommended_fix: Replace active test credentials with placeholder string 'your_stripe_secret_here'.
